interactive.label: Open / Restore
interactive.tooltip: Restore the selected version, or the newest version of the selected project, replacing the current session. Greyed until a row is selected. Double-clicking a row does the same.

interactive.label: Save Current Project
interactive.tooltip: Save all current datasets, fits and instrument state as a new database version of the current project, or as a new project.

interactive.label: Export .cs.pto
interactive.tooltip: Export the selected exact version as a portable project archive. Greyed until a version row is selected.

interactive.label: Import Project
interactive.tooltip: Preview a project archive, check its IDs and import it after confirmation.

interactive.label: Delete Version
interactive.tooltip: Soft-delete the selected version after confirmation; database manage permission is required. Greyed until a version row is selected.

interactive.label: Refresh
interactive.tooltip: Reload the projects from the database.

interactive.label: Inspect Stored Version
interactive.tooltip: Load the stored artifacts, fitted parameter values, branches and version graph of the selected version into the detail tabs below. Greyed until a row is selected.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through finding, inspecting, restoring and saving projects.

interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Explain project versions, restoration, permissions and archives.

interactive.label: search
interactive.tooltip: Search stored project names, identifiers, owners and version notes. The list reloads when you press Enter or click away.

interactive.label: Clear
interactive.tooltip: Empty the search field and show every project again.

interactive.label: Show public
interactive.tooltip: Include projects made readable to other authenticated users.

interactive.label: Show ID
interactive.tooltip: Show or hide the ID column (the project or version identifier). Undecided, it shows when the list is wide enough.

interactive.label: Show status
interactive.tooltip: Show or hide the Status column (the state of a version's last operation). Undecided, it shows when the list is wide enough.

interactive.label: Summary
interactive.tooltip: Show summary for the selected stored project version.

interactive.label: Artifacts
interactive.tooltip: Show artifacts for the selected stored project version.

interactive.label: Parameters
interactive.tooltip: Show parameters for the selected stored project version.

interactive.label: Branches
interactive.tooltip: Show branches for the selected stored project version.

interactive.label: Version graph
interactive.tooltip: Show version graph for the selected stored project version.
Close this window (Escape).

interactive.label: name
interactive.tooltip: Name a new project; a new version of an existing project keeps its project name.

interactive.label: Save version
interactive.tooltip: Serialize the current session and save one new database version.

interactive.label: Cancel
interactive.tooltip: Close this dialog without changing the database.

interactive.label: Delete This Version
interactive.tooltip: Confirm soft deletion of this exact selected version.
